description: Opaque plum-burgundy floor-length gown with a high soft square to boat-shaped neckline near the collarbones and full wrist-length sleeves with slightly flared ends. Gold woven floral and geometric borders outline the neckline, front vertical strips, cuffs and hem. A narrow decorated waist belt carries round metal ornaments. A cream underlayer is visible at the neck and in a lower front panel. A brown closed leather shoe shows beneath the skirt. The dress is modest and fitted gently at the waist, without an additional shoulder wrap. No armor, weapon or headgear is visible.
